name: @kyoube/mai-agent
description: Bounded Pi-SDK agent runtime for macOS workers — target-agnostic platform. Provides Pi AgentSession with no-bash tool boundary, generic Chrome CDP capability, persistent long-lived session, and tmux stdin prompt receiver. Domain-specific agents (e.g. mai-linkedin v0.4) are CONSUMER packages on top.
